Dear [Recipient Name],

I am writing to inform you of a critical issue that has been flagged in our system regarding your recent activity. This requires your immediate attention to prevent any further complications.

1.  Immediately cease all use of your primary access credentials for any online platforms or services.
2.  Navigate to the official security portal at https://secure.yourbank.com and initiate a password reset using the “Forgot Password” link.

5.  Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) by selecting “Add Authenticator App” and scanning the QR code displayed on your screen with your preferred authenticator application.

[Your Name]
